_status: Frozen for the submission. Values were set before training and only ever changed using the 6 development matches; the full feature list is docs/features_list.csv.

ha_features_v2._note: E1 (V2_PLAN.md section 3): fast-reacting possession evidence, physics only. Fixed 15 Nov 2026 BEFORE running. Switched on only with env BH_HA_FEATURES_V2=1; unset = v1 features, unchanged. Touch: the ball's velocity changes by at least touch_dv_min_mps between 0.4 s before and 0.4 s after (a rolling ball loses under about 1.5 m/s over 0.8 s, so a larger change needs a kick or a stop), at the local maximum of that change, with a player within touch_radius_m of the ball; the touching team is the nearer one. Reception: the outgoing minus incoming ball speed is at most reception_dspeed_max_mps (local minimum), same radius rule. All events need the ball observed (not estimated) at t-0.4 s, t and t+0.4 s.

_pitch_m_default: IDSSE and Metrica pitches are 105 x 68 m; BAR-ATH (Phase 8) uses 105.3 x 68.0.

gating._note: Quality columns gate features (NaN when coverage is too low); they are not model inputs (Rulebook 4.10).

windows._note: Centred rolling means and (next 2 s mean - previous 2 s mean). Never across a half boundary (Rulebook D3).

excluded_inputs._note: ball_z: BAR-ATH has no ball height. Quality counts: gating only.
